title: Pick up the red block
description: The operator picks up the red block from the workbench.
instructions: Grasp the red block and lift it clear of the bench surface.

title: Place the red block in the blue bin
description: The red block is placed inside the blue bin on the right.
instructions: Move the red block over the blue bin and release it inside.
success_message: Red block is in the blue bin.

title: Press the green start button
description: The green start button on the control panel is pressed.
instructions: Press and release the green button; the panel light turns on.
success_message: Green button pressed and panel active.
